name: Param Override
description: Caps max_tokens (and max_completion_tokens) on every outgoing body and can drop temperature — for gateways that reject large or hot requests.
author: OFM Extensions maintainers

config.label: max_tokens cap
config.description: Outgoing max_tokens / max_completion_tokens above this cap are lowered to it. Values the gateway already accepts are left alone.

config.label: Drop temperature
config.description: Remove the temperature field from every outgoing body. For servers that reject sampling options.

summary: Caps outgoing max_tokens and optionally strips temperature from every body — fail-open when disabled.
